$schema: NCG Invoice Approval Validation Rules — v1.0
$doc: Single source of truth for approval path determination and required field validation. Read by both the Express backend (services/approvalValidator.js) and exposed via GET /api/approval-schema for frontend consumption.

1.name: Job + Subcontract (within budget)
1.condition: Has job AND subcontract AND invoice amount ≤ subcontract unbilled balance

autoRouting.description: Routing auto-assigned to D (AP Default) if not explicitly set

2.name: Job + No subcontract (or over budget)
2.condition: Has job AND (no subcontract OR invoice amount > unbilled balance)

autoRouting.description: Routing code is required — must be PM code or explicit selection
Routing auto-assigned to D (AP Default) if not explicitly set

multiPhaseOverrides.description: When an invoice is flagged as multi_phase_candidate AND has phase_allocations set, the doc-level phase_code and cost_type are not required — each allocation row carries its own.

guards.condition: multi_phase_candidate === true AND phase_allocations is null
guards.message: Cannot approve: this invoice is on a multi-phase subcontract and requires a phase allocation.

guards.condition: multi_phase_candidate AND phase_allocations set AND invoice amount > subcontract unbilled AND no routing_code
guards.message: Cannot approve: invoice exceeds subcontract unbilled budget and requires PM routing.

codingDefaults.$doc: Advisory coding pre-fill defaults served in GET /api/validate-approval codingDefaults (and additively in GET /api/approval-schema). These are pre-fill HINTS for the client, NOT persisted state: the DB triggers persist only their own case (trg_default_cost_type: matched subcontract with empty cost_type -> 'S'). Precedence is always row/trigger value first; a configured default applies only when the column is unset. costType.subcontractDefault MUST equal the trigger's persisted value so the served hint stays trigger-consistent.

glAccount.description: GL account pre-fill when gl_account is unset: subcontract rows -> 5450, otherwise -> 5300.

costType.description: Cost type pre-fill when cost_type is unset: subcontract rows -> 'S' (trigger-consistent), otherwise -> 'M'.

costTypeGlMap.$doc: Spectrum JC_COST_TYPE_MASTER (Company_Code NCG): cost type -> distribution GL account. Spectrum rejects job-coded lines whose distribution GL does not match this master ('Cost type does not match distribution G/L account'). L (Labor) has no GL account in the master and is intentionally absent.
